notablePrerequisites: Slobad does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing Spine of Ish Sah, adding seven {R} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Spine of Ish Sah leaves the battlefield, triggering itself and Summoning Station.
Resolve the Summoning Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Spine of Ish Sah trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
The Pincher enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying {7}.
Spine of Ish Sah enters the battlefield, destroying target permanent.
Repeat.
